ten_k_highlights: We have a scalable technology that can be used by major banks to improve their loan servicing and credit decisioning processes.
Our revenue has been growing at a rate of 163.1% over the past 5 years, and we expect this growth to continue in the future.
We have a stable share count and no dilution, which will help us to maintain our growth trajectory.
valuation_note: FCF yield 59.9%, PEG 0.1 — attractive entry for the growth.
implied_growth_note: The price assumes only modest growth — a low bar to clear.
